description: Author a president-altitude intelligence brief on a large, enterprise, B2B or PE/public-owned company from public data and reasoning alone — resolve the true entity and parent, gather the public record, find the one central strategic tension, and close with an open brainstorm instead of a pitch. Use when the target doesn't fit a consumer small-business report (multi-state, B2B, thin or non-consumer reviews, no sector benchmark), or when you want a proof-of-capability brief that opens a conversation.
